text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 82-83 पर बहरे दोस्त की मज़ेदार कहानी पढ़ो। वह पहले से जवाब सोचकर जाता है, पर बीमार दोस्त के जवाब कुछ और निकलते हैं!
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 82-83 par behre dost ki mazedaar kahani padho. Woh pehle se jawab sochkar jaata hai, par beemaar dost ke jawab kuchh aur nikalte hain!
text.en: Read the funny story of the deaf friend on pages 82–83. He plans the answers in advance, but his sick friend says something else!

steps.question: Where did the rich man live?
Why did the deaf friend visit the rich man?

questionMeaning.hi: बहरा दोस्त अमीर आदमी से मिलने क्यों गया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Behra dost ameer aadmi se milne kyon gaya?

options: He was ill, and the friend wanted to make him happy.
steps.answer: He was ill, and the friend wanted to make him happy.
steps.modelAnswer: The deaf friend learned that the rich man was ill, so he went to visit him and try to make him happy.

modelMeaning.hi: बहरे दोस्त को पता चला कि अमीर आदमी बीमार है, इसलिए वह उसे ख़ुश करने मिलने गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Behre dost ko pata chala ki ameer aadmi beemaar hai, isliye woh use khush karne milne gaya.

steps.sentence: The deaf man wanted to make the rich man ___.

meaning.hi: बहरा आदमी अमीर आदमी को ख़ुश करना चाहता था।
meaning.hinglish: Behra aadmi ameer aadmi ko khush karna chahta tha.

steps.question: True or false? The deaf man's questions made the rich man happy.

questionMeaning.hi: बहरे आदमी के सवालों से अमीर ख़ुश हुआ।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Behre aadmi ke sawaalon se ameer khush hua.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। सवालों से वह नाराज़ हुआ।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Sawaalon se woh naaraaz hua.

steps.question: True or false? The deaf man said all the ‘wrong’ things because he could not hear the rich man's answers.

questionMeaning.hi: बहरा आदमी जवाब नहीं सुन सका, इसलिए गलत बातें कहीं।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Behra aadmi jawab nahi sun saka, isliye galat baatein kahin.

steps.question: True or false? The deaf man went home, thinking that he had made his friend happy.

questionMeaning.hi: बहरा आदमी यह सोचकर घर गया कि उसने दोस्त को ख़ुश कर दिया।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Behra aadmi yeh sochkar ghar gaya ki usne dost ko khush kar diya.
